Subject: Vendor master intake: legal entity confirmation and PO routing

Hi Maya / AP team,

Thanks for taking the time to work with us — we're getting you into our vendor master so Procurement and Finance can route POs and payments correctly. To create the profile we need the following items (quick list):

- Legal entity name (as registered)
- Tax ID / EIN or VAT number and tax classification (e.g., C-Corp, partnership)
- Registered address and remit-to address
- Invoice contact (email + phone) and preferred invoice submission method (email / portal)
- Bank remittance details or bank verification (voided check or bank letter)
- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached)

I've attached our vendor_onboarding_template.xlsx to speed things up — if you prefer to return a W-9 or a VAT certificate that works too. Once we have the items above we'll: (1) create the vendor master record, (2) set up PO routing to your AP inbox, and (3) inform the requester that the vendor is ready for PO issuance.

Target timeline: if we get these by EOD 12/02 we can aim to have the vendor active before next week.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Partnerships (acting)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Lauren / Priyom — looping Finance on a couple quick verification items before we create the vendor master:

- Thanks to Maya for the W-9 and bank letter. The bank letter looks acceptable but we need either (a) a voided check or (b) a bank account verification letter with the bank letterhead showing routing/account number (last 4). Maya attached a bank letter; can they confirm it includes the routing number in the original? If not, ask for the voided check.
- Confirmed tax classification = C-Corp, so standard 1099 handling (not subject to backup withholding).
- PO routing: Redwood will send POs to accounts@versatek.com by default. If they require a different PO number pattern or subsystem (e.g., PO portal vs. email ingestion), we should capture that now.

Action items:
- Priyom: please create a procurement ticket (PR-8721) to provision the vendor record once we have the final bank verification.
- Lauren: can you confirm whether the requester for the upcoming purchase expects net-30 terms? I'll queue setup for standard net-30 unless you advise otherwise.

I've attached a short sample_po_routing.pdf showing how POs will be formatted and where invoice references should appear.

Marcus Lin
Senior Finance Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: sample_po_routing.pdf (PDF)
